# George Michoulis

> George Michoulis (Greek: Γεώργιος Μιχούλης; also published as Georgios Michoulis) is a software engineer based in Thessaloniki, Greece, moving into agentic software engineering (Software Engineer → Agentic Software Engineer). He builds full-stack and Web3 products, publishes research on blockchain verification, governance and 5G marketplaces, and has lectured in networks, security and application development.

- Website: https://george-michoulis.com/
- Email: gmixoulis@gmail.com
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5139-448X
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=nk0lq8YAAAAJ (56 citations, h-index 3, as of September 2026)
- GitHub: https://github.com/gmixoulis
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/george-michoulis/
- X: https://twitter.com/GeorgeMicou

## Work
- Agentic software engineering (2026 – present): this website is built and maintained by an AI agent pipeline he designed and reviews. An orchestrator agent (Claude Code) writes numbered plans and reviews every diff, an executor agent (Pi with DeepSeek) implements them, and scripted checks gate each step. Write-up: https://george-michoulis.com/garden/built-by-agents/
- Web3 Full-Stack Developer, Cyberscope by TAC (May 2026 – present): end-to-end Web3 products, smart contracts, on-chain integrations, React/Next.js frontends and security tooling.
- Blockchain Developer & Researcher, Sidroco Holdings Ltd (2024 – 2026): an NFT marketplace for 5G networks, Hyperledger Fabric prototypes, an Erasmus+ Moodle LMS, and EU research projects including the Horizon Europe NANCY project.
- Lecturer & Academic Partner, University of Derby / Mediterranean College (2023 – 2025): Networks & Security, Web Scripting, Application Development.
- Blockchain & Full-Stack Developer, University of Nicosia, Institute For the Future (2022 – 2024): large Next.js, NestJS, Flask and Docker applications, and a Web3 NFT marketplace.
- Freelance WordPress developer (2018 – 2021), including sites for Aristotle University of Thessaloniki's Jean Monnet Chair and Center for European Legal Culture.

## Education
- MSc in Data and Web Science, Aristotle University of Thessaloniki (2020 – 2022), funded by a DeepMind scholarship. Thesis: "Graph Embedding and Node Features for Drug-Target Interaction Prediction" (DOI 10.26262/heal.auth.ir.338875).
- BSc in Applied Informatics, University of Macedonia (2015 – 2020). Thesis (in Greek): "Verifying the validity of academic qualifications with blockchain technology" (https://dspace.lib.uom.gr/handle/2159/24707). English translation: https://george-michoulis.com/docs/michoulis-bsc-thesis-2020-en.pdf
